ruflo.instructions: Ruflo is the memory backbone, NOT an agent backbone — the agentic MCP surface (agent_execute/agent_spawn/swarm_*/hive-mind_*/coordination_*/autopilot_*) is bookkeeping-only under subscription, never use it for execution (ADR-059). Namespaces: 'knowledge' (facts, patterns, learnings — use for recall and storage), 'pattern' (reusable code/skill patterns — use for cross-session promotion), 'session' (ephemeral session state — query with threshold 0.55+, never use namespace 'all' below 0.55 as session records score constant 0.5 and contaminate results). Core tools: memory_search (recall), memory_store (persist), pattern-search/store (skill patterns). Claims: claims_claim/release/mark-stealable (advisory task locking). Sanctioned execution: testgen_tdd_repair — the one genuinely subscription-native MCP execution path (spawns claude -p, budget-capped, test-verified; branch on data.repaired, never success). Broken on this install: agentdb_hierarchical-store/recall and the wider agentdb_* bridge (ControllerRegistry duplicate-export crash, t-2757) — use memory_search/memory_store instead. Stub tools to avoid (not implemented): aidefence_*, ruvllm_*, wasm_agent_prompt, daa_*, embeddings_rabitq_*.
